rationale: The original entry thesis relied on price holding above the 5-minute 9-EMA ($27.18), which has now been violated to the downside as the most recent 1-minute bar closed at $27.15 on expanding selling volume (29,114 shares). Additionally, the broad market has deteriorated further since entry (SPY dropping from -1.26% to -1.37%), creating a growing headwind. With momentum rolling over through key short-term support and a tight remaining daily loss budget, closing early at the $27.17 ask rather than waiting for the $27.10 invalidation preserves capital.
